verdict.rationale: uv's own docs state it supports Cargo-style workspaces for scalable projects, so the monorepo-workspace capability is first-party. The pack only implies, without documenting, a single shared workspace lockfile (the uv.lock evidence describes a project lockfile) or cross-linked local workspace dependencies. missing for 10: explicit documentation that workspace members share one uv.lock, documentation of cross-linked local/editable member dependencies, in-depth workspace docs content, independent or hands-on corroboration of monorepo use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage many packages in one monorepo with workspaces sharing a single lockfile and cross-linked local dependencies

citations.quote: Supports Cargo-style workspaces for scalable projects.
`uv.lock` is a cross-platform lockfile that contains exact information about your project's dependencies.
